title: Daily Intelligence Brief - June 28, 2026 (overnight scan)
summary: Parliament stays risen; feeds skew to the Alberta fall-separation-referendum run-up, the 24 Sussex restoration, wildfires (Lynn Lake evacuation; 66 fires in N.W.T.) and several officer-involved shootings (Edmonton, Cold Lake). The standout, most investigation-relevant signal is a DIRECT procurement hit: Ottawa SUSPENDED the $800M Griffon helicopter life-extension program over technical 'complexity' and cost, with doubt over upgrading all 82 aircraft while weighing a multibillion-dollar alternative -- a FOURTH defence-procurement data point that broadens the velocity/distortion cluster (Arctic radar + submarine + L3Harris/Saab) to include a troubled-program pause/pivot. JUSTICE/GOVERNANCE: the Liberals publicly recast themselves as 'the party of law and order'; retired judge Corrine Sparks was added to a federal diversity council after pushback. ECONOMY/INDIGENOUS: construction is set to begin on the first road into Ontario's Ring of Fire (consent/critical-minerals fast-track). The 24 Sussex donor-list transparency pledge is confirmed. No direct MAID/CIJA/lobbying-registry hits. All three feeds pulled verbatim (CBC 403 bypassed). Threat level AMBER.
